title: The summarize test skips rows it cannot match and expects a row that is not printed
body:
The `summarize` test (`sufr/tests/cli.rs:1146-1165`) looks up each row with the regex `[|] <row>\s+[|] ([^|]+)` (1133) and asserts only inside `if let Some(caps)` (1136). A row that does not match is skipped without failing. The test expects a row named `Num Suffixes` (1155). The CLI prints that row as `Len Suffixes` (`sufr/src/lib.rs`, rows built at 573-636). That expectation is skipped, so the test passes without checking it.

Seen by reading the code in the survey. The test was not run.
